Soil stress and deformation for arbitrary surface load

(by integration of the Boussinesq formula)

Dimensions of loaded area - a = 2 m , b = 3 m

Surface load - p ( x; y )  = 100 kPa · (1 + xa)

Elastic modulus - E0 = 20 MPa

Poisson ratio - ν = 0.3

Stress equations

R ( x; y; z )  =    √ x2 + y2 + z2

Vertical - σz ( x; y; z )  = 32 · π ·  b2∫-b2  a2∫-a2 p  ( xp; yp )  · z3R  ( x − xp; y − yp; z ) 5 dxp dyp

Shear - τxz ( x; y; z )  = 32 · π ·  b2∫-b2  a2∫-a2 p  ( xp; yp )  ·  ( x − xp )  · z2R  ( x − xp; y − yp; z ) 5 dxp dyp

Shear - τyz ( x; y; z )  = 32 · π ·  b2∫-b2  a2∫-a2 p  ( xp; yp )  ·  ( y − yp )  · z2R  ( x − xp; y − yp; z ) 5 dxp dyp

Deformation equations

d ( x; y )  = 1 − ν2E0 ·  H∫H0 σz  ( x; y; z )  dz
